text:
sophia: quick heads-up — during tsunami-v1 quant bring-up I saw parentheses/bracket duplication when mixing Arabic and Chinese in the same sentence. looks quant-specific.

sophia: minimal repro (canary tsunami-v1.q4):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"tsunami-v1.q4","input":"今天的新闻 (التقرير) 完成了。"}'
```

sophia: expected: 今天的新闻 (التقرير) 完成了。
sophia: observed: 今天的新闻 ((التقرير)) 完成了。  <-- extra parens around Arabic phrase

mei: interesting. does tokenizer split the paren separately or attach to RTL run? can you paste tokens + bidi?

sophia: token dump from canary q4 run:
```
tokens: ["今天","的","新闻"," ","(","תא-rtl?","التقرير"," ",")"," ","完成","了","。"]
bidi: [LTR,LTR,LTR,WS,ON,RTL,RTL,WS,ON,WS,LTR,LTR,ON]
```

sophia: the "(" token is ON class; runtime seems to duplicate it when reconstructing text from kvcache indices in the q4 path.

luca: noted — we recently changed small-token packing offsets in q4 kernel to optimize cache layout. small parity shift can change attention indices for ON tokens surrounded by RTL.

tariq: can reproduce locally with synthetic mixes. int8 and fp16 are clean. q4 only. starting bisect across q4 kernel commits.

luca: if this is index mapping, adding an assert on token->kvcache offsets for ON around strong-rtl runs should catch it in unit tests. will add.

l10n-bot: created locale test set "ar-zh-paren" (800 examples) and ran initial eval: tsunami-v1.fp16 BLEU 6.8; tsunami-v1.q4 BLEU 3.9; tsunami-v1.int8 BLEU 6.7. attached sample fail list to /datasets/locale-onboard/ar-zh-paren/fails-1729998888.json

ci-bot: kicked off bisect job job-5543. will run A/B across commits and report candidate. ETA ~35m.

mei: if kernel change is the culprit we should consider a temporary routing rule: detect strong-rtl + CJK -> prefer int8 on canary/dedicated until fix. low-risk mitigation.

tariq: bisect narrowed it to commit bb7a..c2d0 which is the small-token alignment change. running a build with alignment disabled.

luca: thanks. i'll prototype asserts and an alignment-off build for q4.

ci-bot: bisect complete. culprit commit c1b2ea (small-token pack tweak) confirmed. A/B: alignment off = no dup paren.

sophia: great. can you push hotfix toggle that disables packing for ON tokens near RTL?

luca: pushed hotfix: q4-disable-on-pack. CI: run locale regression.

ci-bot: Deploy canary: tsunami-v1.q4-hotfix. Locale regression ar-zh-paren results: BLEU q4-hotfix 6.6 (fp16 6.8). spot-check sample set: no duplicated parens observed.

mei: please add token-level unit tests covering: RTL-surrounded ON tokens, mixed neutral punctuation, and standalone ZWJ/ZWNJ cases. also add a small monitor in canary for 48h.

tariq: added unit tests + synthetic harness. PR #4201 opened, assign @luca and @mei for review.

luca: also adding a soft routing rule for canary that prefers int8 for requests with both CJK and Arabic/Hebrew scripts until stable. will mark rule as canary-only.

sophia: thx all. keeping watch on metric dashboard; saved failing examples to /tmp/tsunami-q4-ar-zh-fails.json. ping me if anything odd in the next 24h. :pray:
